text:
Alex K.: hey folks — opened a PR to slim examples and reconcile some dead links for the structured output guide: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4567. need a quick pair of eyes on snippet correctness and anchor updates.
Maria B.: on it. can you point to the specific files to trim? i skimmed and it looks like a lot of duplicated long examples.
Alex K.: mostly the long_examples.md under /guides/structured-output and the old migration notes. plan: keep one canonical minimal example + two edgecases. also want to standardize the example envelope to the new action-response shape.
Sam L.: is the action-response envelope the new official shape? saw some SDK snippets still using the older tool envelope.
Maria B.: yes — the new canonical shape is: { action: "name", args: {...}, response: { status, payload } } — small change but touches a lot of snippets.
Jordan P.: i can run a grep/replace for anchors and update links to point at the new spec page. can also add redirect anchors on the old page if we want backwards compat.
Alex K.: thanks. two blockers before merge: 1) docs-approved wording for nullable payload example; 2) the fenced code examples were rendering weirdly in hugo because of leading spaces — want to avoid that.
Maria B.: for nullable payloads i propose this tiny example: payload: null // allowed. will paste into the PR.
Alex K.: here's the snippet i'm planning to keep:```json
{ "action": "get_user", "args": { "id": 123 }, "response": { "status": "ok", "payload": null } }
```
dev-bot: link-checker report: 12 broken links found in docs/guides/structured-output (see CI).
Sam L.: :eyes: i'll triage the broken links tomorrow morning. can we also consider collapsing the big examples page into small tabs to reduce scroll?
Maria B.: tabs are okay but prefer less JS complexity in docs. i'd rather keep a single canonical page and move "expanded examples" into a separate MD file with clear anchors. easier for search and for redirects.
Jordan P.: pushed a branch that fixes most anchors + replaces old links with /spec/structured-output. opened a PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4570.
Alex K.: added @Maria B. and @Sam L. as reviewers on the examples-reorg PR. if reviewers sign off by EOD we can merge tonight and run a docs rebuild.
Maria B.: quick pass done, left two tiny wording nits around behavior descriptions.
Sam L.: left comment about SDK snippet: in the Python SDK we should call client.call_action(...) not client.invoke(...). better for clarity.
Alex K.: good catch — i'll update the sample. also need a short backcompat note for folks on older SDKs.
Jordan P.: will add a migration blurb linking to the compatibility doc in /guides/migration.
Alex K.: last ask before merge: can someone run the markdown linter? previously it failed on a few frontmatter YAML spacing issues.
Sam L.: i'll run the linter after lunch and address any failures. if green i'll merge.
Maria B.: merged! :tada:
dev-bot: docs-build succeeded — preview: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-4567 
Alex K.: amazing, thanks everyone.
